title: IdentityRefV1
description: Floating reference to a stable identity (document 16 section 3.3, shared foundation section 4.2). Exactly five fields. It carries no version_id, no hash, and no implied-current behavior. It is permitted only where the owning domain schema marks navigation, discovery, or whole-lineage semantics.
$comment: unevaluatedProperties:false rather than additionalProperties:false: additionalProperties cannot see $ref-composed properties, and section 4.1 forbids restating the composed rules locally. The effect is identical - exactly the five declared properties are accepted.

floating_resolution_policy.$comment: A command that resolves a floating identity declares independent valid_at and known_at plus the registered resolver policy. One undifferentiated timestamp is invalid (document 16 section 3.3).

floating_navigation_ref.$comment: The only released shape that may carry an IdentityRef into a command: the floating ref plus its explicit resolution policy and the resulting persisted pin.
